description: This PHP source file defines the SchemaController class within the SuiteCRM API v8, handling schema-related endpoints such as retrieving the JSON API schema and Swagger schema. It includes methods for reading schema files and returning their contents, as well as error handling.

classes.name: SchemaController
classes.description: Controller class managing schema endpoints to retrieve JSON API and Swagger schemas, extending ApiController.

methods.name: getJsonApiSchema
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to retrieve the JSON API schema file contents, reading from the path provided by JsonApi object.

methods.name: getSwaggerSchema
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to retrieve the Swagger schema file contents, reading a static swagger.json file.
